item.title: How to create and delete a non default CalDAV calendar using curl
item.description:
• Draft created: Aug 2, 2026 05:03 (UTC). From: github.com/thunderbird/desktop-support-tools/blob/main/README.md:

Make a calendar

curl -i -u nemo@thundermail.com -X MKCALENDAR \
-H 'Content-Type: application/xml' \
--data '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<C:mkcalendar xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><D:set><D:prop><D:displayname>ticket-1234</D:displayname></D:prop></D:set></C:mkcalendar>' \
'https://mail.thundermail.com/dav/cal/nemo%40thundermail.com/ticket-1234/'

Delete a calendar

curl -i -u "$CAL_USER" -X DELETE "${CAL_HOME}ticket-1234/"

item.description:
Discovered: Jul 25, 2026 04:19 (UTC) ME:: gotta read Wilson’s translations of Greek Classics that those jerks hate! Rebecca Solnit:: Listening to Cassandra: Misogyny, Classical and Modern

  • QUOTE: But it wasn't just style; there was a death-of-civilization-level panic as if Homer speaking through a woman, a woman speaking with the authority to take on a foundational classic, was annihilation for something or other. They insisted that she had done something to it she wasn't allowed to do and that somehow it was damaged as a result (one hysterical social media post made it sound like she was somehow destroying all other versions so we now and forever after could only read her version). A woman speaking could, in their ears, only be threatening. Beard writes, "For a start it doesn’t much matter what line you take as a woman, if you venture into traditional male territory, the abuse comes anyway. It’s not what you say that prompts it, it’s the fact you’re saying it."

In the late 1890s, under the guise of friendship, the US staged the Battle of Manila to pretend to help fight off the Spanish colonizers. Then they turned around and became our colonizer. 🤷🏻‍♀️
item.description:
Discovered: Jul 21, 2026 06:22 (UTC) The Americans killed thousands (if not tens of thousands or 100,000 or more) Filipinos in this war and we’ve forgotten about it even though it’s not a hidden conspiracy theory. See Karnow’s In our Image for a biased American history of this ; Mmina Maclang Tamayo aka @thoughtspresso:: It doesn’t escape me as someone from a former US colony (and in many ways continue to be under Uncle Sam’s thumb), that they indeed brought a gift horse to our shores. In the late 1890s, under the guise of friendship, the US staged the Battle of Manila to pretend to help fight off the Spanish colonizers. Then they turned around and became our colonizer. 🤷🏻‍♀️

References

  • Wikipedia: In Our Image: America’s Empire in the Philippines
  • Wikipedia: The Philippine–American War, known alternatively as the Filipino–American War, Philippine Insurrection, or Tagalog Insurgency

    • Filipino casualties were much greater than among Americans. The United States Department of State states that the war “resulted in the death of over 4,200 American and over 20,000 Filipino combatants”, and that “as many as 200,000 Filipino civilians died from violence, famine, and disease” … A cholera epidemic “1902 cholera outbreak of the Philippines”) at the war’s end killed between 150,000 and 200,000 people.20 According to Andrea Pitzer, over 11,000 Filipinos died in concentration camps.

    • Some estimates reach 1,000,000 dead…..Filipino scholar Luzviminda Francisco cites an alleged interview in The New York Times with General James M. Bell, who commanded forces in a part of southern Luzon, in May 1901 where it was said he suggested that “over 600,000 people in Luzon alone had been killed or had died of disease as a result of the war”. Francisco also cites the forced incarceration of a reported 300,000 people in the province of Albay, and allegations of war crimes in Mindanao and high death rates in Bilibid Prison to raise doubts of the validity of, then, accepted casualty figures for the war. …Historian John M. Gates has described the figure of 600,000 as unfounded and exaggerated …According to Gates, the maximum possible number of war-related deaths in the Philippines between 1898 and 1903 is 321,000 based on American and Spanish census data
